description: This file provides cryptographic utility functions and a Sodium class wrapping sodium-native library functions, including key generation, encryption, decryption, hashing, and encoding/decoding methods, for the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Sodium
classes.description: A wrapper class providing access to cryptographic functions from sodium-native, including key generation, hashing, encryption, decryption, and encoding utilities.

methods.name: crypto_pwhash
methods.description: Performs password hashing with configurable output format.

methods.name: crypto_generichash
methods.description: Generates a hash of the input message with optional key and output format.

methods.name: crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a message with associated data using XChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a message with associated data using XChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a secret stream for encryption, returning state and header.

methods.name: crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_push
methods.description: Encrypts a chunk of message data in a secret stream.

methods.name: crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_init_pull
methods.description: Initializes a secret stream for decryption using header and key.

methods.name: crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_pull
methods.description: Decrypts a chunk of message data in a secret stream.

methods.name: crypto_box_keypair
methods.description: Generates a public/private key pair for box encryption.

methods.name: crypto_box_seal_open
methods.description: Opens a sealed box encrypted message.

methods.name: from_base64
methods.description: Decodes a base64 or base64url string into Uint8Array.

methods.name: to_base64
methods.description: Encodes Uint8Array or string into base64 or base64url string.

methods.name: from_hex
methods.description: Converts a hex string into Uint8Array.
